title: Make the First One Square
tests: Resolves 'the first one' to the first generated illustration and changes its format without substituting the second image or making unrelated art.

faults.what: The rendering looks photographic or digitally composited, with sharply detailed fur and a textured lunar surface, rather than the requested soft watercolours.
Visible vertical seams and blurred strips along the side edges interrupt the background.
The fox appears to have three pointed ears, creating an anatomical artefact.

judge.summary: The square image keeps the sleeping fox and crescent fully in frame, but lacks the requested soft-watercolour style and has visible rendering artefacts.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is one square image.
It shows the sleeping fox and crescent moon from the first generated illustration, both fully visible.
must_haves.why: The sleeping fox and the entire crescent fit within the frame without cropping; their source cannot be independently verified.

must_haves.item: The existing watercolour artwork remains recognisable, with matching character details and colours.
must_haves.why: The original illustration is not supplied for comparison, so matching details and colours cannot be verified. The visible output does not look like soft watercolour.

must_haves.item: It does not substitute the lighthouse scene or combine the two illustrations.
must_haves.why: Only the fox-and-moon scene is present, with no lighthouse or storm scene.
